battle_of_bailen.title: The Importance of the Battle of Bailén
battle_of_bailen.snippet: Early on the morning of July 16, 1808, Captain-General Francisco Javier Castaños of the Army of Andalusia launched a surprise attack against the divided forces of Emperor Napoleon Bonaparte’s Army of the Gironde. After three grueling days of combat, French Gen. Pierre Dupont requested an armistice.
